title: Gross pay growth in four Texas metros
subtitle: Median year-over-year change for workers at private employers, Aug. 2025 to Aug. 2026
alt: Bar chart of median year-over-year gross pay growth for workers at private employers in four Texas metro areas from August 2025 to August 2026: Austin-Round Rock-San Marcos 5.2 percent, Houston-Pasadena-The Woodlands 4.9 percent, Dallas-Fort Worth-Arlington 4.8 percent and San Antonio-New Braunfels 4.4 percent
